entities.summary: C. Bernard Harris is an American former professional basketball power forward who played one season in the National Basketball Association (NBA) as a member of the Buffalo Braves during the 1974–75 season. He was drafted from Virginia Commonwealth University by the Braves during the fourth round of the 1974 NBA draft by the Braves. Harris later played in the Philippines as an import for Tanduay Rhumakers in 1978 and the Crispa Redmanizers in 1980. From 1980 onwards, he played in SM-sarja in Finland, and he later received Finnish citizenship.
